status: Completed sole requested native consumer dossier; server category constant proved, DTO field binding remains unknown
scope: Only installed native binary bytes, existing native evidence and static Capstone analysis; own findings/supporting evidence. No production, Git, account/profile/window access or target/business network requests.

observed.compiledOperation: Native ilikelogic.cpp assertion at 0x10b01728 names m_pCatMgr->GetCatIDFromSvrID(qqmusic::GetQQUinEx(), ATL::CComBSTR(L"201"), &nILikeCatID). This is a binary-embedded operation description, not an account playlist name or array-position inference.
observed.actualArgumentBytes: UTF16 literal at 0x10a5cc70 is 201. The actual Capstone consumer at 0x104e6c40 pushes that address at 0x104e6c84, allocates a BSTR using OLEAUT32 ordinal2, reads current UIN via Common GetQQUinEx IAT0x109c1474 (unsigned64 return), and passes the string plus current UIN to category-manager virtual slot+0xc0 at 0x104e6cbc.
observed.predicate: After the call succeeds, it compares incoming native event/record+0x18 to the returned local category ID at 0x104e6cea. Only equality and event/record+4>0 trigger 0x104e6bb0. Field source and event type have not been reconstructed, so these offsets are not named as server DTO fields.
observed.corroboratingConsumers: The same compiled operation and 201 argument also appear at candidate 0x104e6d50 and the CMyMusicFrameMgr::CheckILikeListOK-labeled candidate 0x1066fe30. Separate GetSongsOfCat assertions name the resolved nILikeCatID. No extra dossier was requested for these candidates.
observed.boundedConclusion: Native liked-category logic uses a fixed server-category string 201 scoped to the current UIN, then resolves a local category identity before comparison. The value is established from native operands and operation labels, not guessed from a response item or a common online value.

limitations: Unresolved computed or indirect flows without target addresses are not represented as reference edges.
Thunk and external classifications are Ghidra FunctionManager observations; they do not resolve targetless calls.
Pseudocode and assembly are Ghidra-specific representations, not original source or Hopper-equivalent text.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.

integrationLimit: A final likedPlaylist/fetchLikedTracks rule needs that binding plus verified current-user ownership. Default category201 is independent of localized playlist title, array order and track count. No production heuristic was added.
